name: InterContinental Geneve
positioning: InterContinental Geneve is a city hotel near Lake Geneva and the United Nations Office, with lake, mountain and city-view suites, a Spa Cinq Mondes and a seasonal outdoor pool.
best_for: Travelers who want suites with views of Mont Blanc, Lake Geneva and the Jet d'Eau
Visitors to the United Nations Office and the international quarter
Families wanting a dedicated family suite

facts.text: The hotel is near Lake Geneva.
The hotel offers easy access to landmarks ranging from the United Nations Office to upscale shopping along Rue du Rhone.
The Ariana Museum is about half a kilometer from the hotel.
Rooms and suites offer city and alpine views.
The Residence Suite was designed by New York architect Tony Chi.
The Presidential Lake View Suites have panoramic views of Mont Blanc and Lake Geneva.
The Family Suite is designed for families, with generous space, comfort and privacy.
The hotel's spa is a Spa Cinq Mondes, focused on beauty rituals for relaxation and renewal.
The hotel has a seasonal outdoor heated pool.
The hotel's Cigar Lounge was designed by Tony Chi.
Woods serves a Sunday brunch where fresh, locally sourced ingredients take centre stage.
Les Nations Bar & Lounge is an intimate setting for classic cocktails.

highlights.text: The Residence Suite has a 360-degree view of Geneva, including the Jet d'Eau.
The Panoramic Lake View Suites look out on Mont Blanc, Lake Geneva and the Jet d'Eau fountain.
The concierge team brings Clefs d'Or expertise to finding the city's most beautiful places and hidden gems.
In summer the outdoor pool is a lush green oasis in the heart of the city.

considerations.text: The outdoor pool is seasonal and open only in summer.
WhataHotel notes an urban setting with city traffic and a business atmosphere.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects Geneva's high-end market.
